# Vtronix

Vtronix designs and manufactures HVAC electronic controls, control boards, and thermostats. The site says the company meets ISO, UL, CSA, and CE. Quality control starts with inspection of incoming parts and continues through 100 percent in-circuit, functional, and automatic optical inspection testing. The production line is in an electrostatically controlled, fully air conditioned facility. Finished product is inventoried and distributed from the warehouse in Miami Gardens, Florida.

Mailing address: PO Box 267096, Weston FL 33326
Email: sales@vtronix.com
Phone: 305-471-7600

Prices are not shown online. Use Request a Quote on a product page, or the contact form, to contact Vtronix.
https://www.vtronix.com/contact-us
